title: Daande Goonga Jamanuuji ɓooyɗi
intro: Won ruuhu e nder Quraan mo daartol mum haalaa e aayeeji seeɗa tan, kono sifaaji mum en tedduɗi ina njalba e laaɓal jalboowal. Joom baawɗe yetti ɗum ngam moƴƴere teeŋtunde, ooɗoo maccuɗo ɓooyɗo yurmeende ina jogii nokku e nder kelle wahyu. Gollal maa ko anndude ndeeɗoo limoore teskinde. Mbele aɗa waawi teskaade hol ɓe ngoni?
clues: Miin ko mi annabi Allah guurnooɗo hakkunde yontaaji gadani neɗɗaagu.
Alla siftinii kam e nder deftere mum e annabaaɓe woɗɓe, kamɓe fof ɓe njettaama e moƴƴere teddunde wootere.
Miɗo siforee neɗɗo gooŋɗinɗo e nder Quraan.
Allah umminii kam e darnde toownde nde seeɗa e woɗɓe keɓi.
Innde am ina siftinaa e Suura Al-Anbiya, hawrude e annabaaɓe ɗiɗo woɗɓe yettaaɓe e muñal mum en.
Miin ko mi Idris, annabi gooŋɗinɗo toowɗo.

identity.label: Hol ko ngonmi?
options: Annabi Idriisa
Annabi Nuuhu
Annabi Ibraahiima
Annabi Muusaa
Annabi Ismaa’il

trial.label: Ñaawoore/Kewu
options: Siggude muñal e goonga, caggal ɗuum toownaa e darnde toownde
Mahde laana mawka ngam hisnude nuɗɗinɓe e ilam bonɗam
Wontude e nder yiite ngulnge, yaltude tawa alaa ko bonnata ɗum haa laaɓi
Haɓde e laamɗo baawɗo, foolde konu mum maagiyaŋkooɓe
Wuurde e nder reedu liɗɗi mawɗi e nder lugge maayo
trial.answer: Siggude muñal e goonga, caggal ɗuum toownaa e darnde toownde

location.label: Elemen keyɗo
options: Darnde toownde toownde toownde to Alla
Laana mawka mahraaka e leɗɗe, pittaali e tar
Yiite ɓuuɓnge ɗe rewooɓe sanamuuji laamɗo bonɗo ɓuuɓnata
Geec mawɗo feccii e laabi joorɗi
Reedu ɓaleeru baleejo mawɗo to les maayo
location.answer: Darnde toownde toownde toownde to Alla

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: Naataaɗo e yurmeende Alla ko gooto e moƴƴuɓe
Hisnaama wondude e goonɗinɓe fof e ilam adunaaru nduu
Yahi e nder ƴiiwoonde nde yiite memotaako
Ardii Ɓiɓɓe Isra'iila bee jam haa ndimu haa sera maayo
Hawri e galle maɓɓe giɗo caggal duuɓi juutɗi e caɗeele
outcome.answer: Naataaɗo e yurmeende Alla ko gooto e moƴƴuɓe

arabic: وَإِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِدْرِيسَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ ۖ كُلٌّۭ مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And [mention] Ishmael and Idrees and Dhul-Kifl; all were of the patient. (21:85)
